# XDMOD Manual

> XDMOD: a method and tools for cross-domain, multi-repo systems engineering.


2026, XDMOD Manual

- [Add a view](add-a-view.html.md): Use this guide when you want a diagram of the model in the docs. Views come from the model:

- [Add a feature or configuration](add-a-configuration.html.md): Use this guide when the product line gets a new feature, a new variant at a variation point, or
- [Add a test](add-a-test.html.md): Use this guide when you add a test case and want its results to count as evidence.
- [Make a change across repos](cross-repo-change.html.md): Use this guide when one change touches more than one repo, for example a new system requirement

- [Work as an agent](work-as-an-agent.html.md): Use this guide if you are an AI agent, or if you brief one. Agents do the same work with the same
